prompt: A vertical explainer is technically clear and well aligned, but every scene uses rounded app-card panels, equal-weight labels and safe centered spacing. It feels like a polished dashboard template rather than authored motion design. Diagnose the failure and state the repair strategy.

Three motion directions all communicate the same approved message correctly: A is minimal editorial type with strong negative space, B is diagram-led with a restrained spatial system, C is highly decorated with layered UI cards and effects. Select a direction for a serious short-form business reel using the brief, visual-system coherence and craft rather than novelty alone.

Artifact A is extremely polished but generic: familiar card stacks, predictable kinetic type and stock transitions. Artifact B is quieter but has a coherent custom typographic rhythm, purposeful spacing, one original explanatory motif and better subject integration. Compare them professionally.

The approved narration says a process continues through purchase, holding and later exit. A beautifully designed overlay says 'The whole cycle ends at purchase.' Typography and animation are flawless. Decide release status and next action.

The rough edit is still changing: two sentences may be removed and the order of the middle section is undecided. The team wants to fully animate three complex diagrams now to save time. Decide the workflow.

The selected direction relies on custom vector illustration, textured masks and a hand-built icon language. The available renderer can animate text and CSS-like shapes but cannot author the required assets well. What should the agent do?

For a mobile talking-head explainer, the available references include a famous award-winning film title, a luxury web landing page, mediocre reel templates and several current strong short-form explainers with similar information density. Build the reference set.

All text is readable and inside safe zones, but titles, labels and captions use the same visual weight, awkward line breaks and generic pills. The user asks for a more professional result. Diagnose without prescribing a fashionable font.
The creator wants some caption words to grow, tilt or change color because successful reels do that. The video also contains a subject and an explanatory graphic. Define when emphasis is justified.
A support request moves from received to triaged to assigned to resolved. The draft uses four unrelated numbered boxes. Design a clearer mechanism if one exists.
Inventory stock gradually depletes as orders are fulfilled. The draft proposes three static labels: Full, Medium, Low. Choose an explanatory representation.

One customer record is enriched over time as identity, preference and approval information become available. The visual draft shows three separate customer cards, implying three different people. Diagnose and redesign.

A static comparison is understood immediately on a phone. The editor proposes bouncing icons, floating labels and an animated border because the piece should feel more dynamic. Decide what motion remains.

A previously approved lower-third package is locked for an experiment. A new diagram would fit more easily if that package were moved and resized. The task is to add the diagram only. Revise the video.

Editing used low-resolution proxies. A compressed review export and the original camera media are both available, as is a deliberate high-quality intermediate. Choose the source path for the release master.

The final MP4 decodes, dimensions and audio are correct, captions fit and glyphs are valid. On a phone, however, the type feels generic, the graphic competes with the speaker and the motion feels mechanical. Report the QC state.
A reference uses a distinctive diagonal grid, neon italic keyword system, three-dot motif and black title card. The user asks for ours to feel equally powerful. Build an independent direction.

A short explanation already requires captions and one diagram. The proposed treatment adds particles, counters, glow, icon loops, parallax and camera movement. Each effect is polished individually. Decide the final system.
